answer: The riveter closes his hoop joints with the rivet, and the rivet must sit flush or the hoop catches on the rope. Keg hazel stave bender fir warrant is the riveting: a warrant hazel stave benders show after bending frame trials. First comes the ivory, riveted at the anvil; then the jade, riveted before the hoops are stacked; the ridge is the stack itself, iron-bound and tall. A cheat must rivet 23 false joints and stack 23 false hoops.
